name: laa-mods
description: Mods for the laa toolkit: blocks file changes and commits on the default branch, tracks the running laa pipeline above the prompt, in the footer, the spinner, and the prompt hint, draws a stepper, engine cards, and framed closing reports, adds /laa-help, panes to triage learnings and review findings, and next-step suggestions. Set visuals to minimal for the plain 0.3.0 drawing.

guard.title: Default-branch guard
guard.description: Where to block edits and commits on the default branch: repos adopted by laa (.claude/laa/ exists), every git repo, or nowhere.

visuals.title: Visuals
visuals.description: How much laa draws: full adds the stepper under the band, engine and report cards, the run in the spinner and the prompt hint, and the visual panes; minimal keeps the band, the footer, and the panes exactly as 0.3.0 drew them.
